title: private-installer: add multi-AZ VPC provisioning, interface endpoints, peering, Route53, and upgrade/rollback hooks
author: Ananya Kapoor
description: Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in VPC environments requested a repeatable, multi-AZ control plane provisioning workflow that includes subnet allocation, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone wiring. This PR expands the private-installer Terraform module and the on-prem upgrade hooks to: 1) create multi-AZ private subnets and route tables for control-plane instances, 2) provision interface endpoints for SSM/EC2/SecretsManager and internal S3 access, 3) manage security groups with least-privilege ingress/egress for control-plane components, 4) automate cross-account VPC peering with optional Route53 Resolver rules and Route53 private hosted zone associations, and 5) add upgrade and rollback hooks that reconcile networking resources during in-place upgrades (preflight checks, drift detection, and safe rollback steps). Summary of changes: - Terraform: new module private_control_plane/vpc with submodules for subnets, endpoints, peering, and route53 associations. Module is idempotent and supports multi-account peering via a peering-requests workflow. - Installer: private-installer templates updated to reference the module outputs, new vars for az_count/cidr_pools, and helm values merge for networking. - Helm charts: values schema updated to allow explicit control-plane ENI configs and securityGroup ids. - Upgrade hooks: add pre-upgrade networking check, create-missing-endpoints step, and rollback step that can undo peering associations created during the upgrade. - Tests/docs: added Terraform unit tests using terratest, integration acceptance test in perf-canary for multi-AZ provisioning, and docs/upgrade.md describing the new flags and recommended rollback procedure. Backwards compatibility: module exposes legacy variables (vpc_id, subnet_ids) and will not modify existing subnets unless enable_subnet_management=true. Rollback semantics: rollback hook will only remove resources it created during the current run if --unsafe-rollback is passed; otherwise it attempts to revert to previous known-good outputs and fails safe. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module with multi-AZ support - [x] Interface endpoints + SGs - [x] Cross-account peering workflow - [x] Route53 private hosted zone association - [x] Upgrade/rollback hooks + docs - [x] Terratest and CI integration Testing performed: terratest suite (unit) on module, end-to-end provisioning in a dedicated test account (multi-AZ, peering to a simulated tenant VPC), helm-lint and chart install in kind cluster for values schema validation. Known limitations: Route53 Resolver rules require permissions in both accounts; cross-account delegation still manual for some enterprise setups (documented). Related: ENG-1024, OPS-210, INFRA-897.
commits: feat(terraform): add private_control_plane/vpc module with submodules for subnets, endpoints, peering
feat(installer): wire new module outputs into private-installer templates and variables
chore(helm): bump chart values schema to support explicit eni/securityGroup configuration
feat(upgrade): add networking preflight and rollback hooks
test(terraform): add terratest suite for multi-az provisioning
docs: add upgrade.md and network design notes
review_comments: Ethan Zhao (review): Security group rules look permissive for the control-plane-ssh SG; can we tighten to only management CIDR + bastion SG?
Ananya Kapoor (author): Updated control-plane SG to restrict SSH to management_cidr and added explicit description tags. Left a flag enable_ssh_bastion for customers needing broader access.
Marisol Vega (review): Cross-account peering flow is complex — add explicit IAM guidance and a retryable peering-requests pattern in docs.
Ananya Kapoor (author): Added peering workflow docs + example script to accept peering from tenant account; added idempotency via peering_request_tags.
Liam O'Connor (review): Upgrade rollback step should not delete peering unilaterally. Suggest we require --unsafe-rollback and add audit log entry for peering deletions.
Ananya Kapoor (author): Implemented --unsafe-rollback guard and audit log emit; updated upgrade.md with recommended operator steps.
release_notes: Add multi-AZ VPC provisioning for the private control plane. New Terraform module supports subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone associations. Includes safe upgrade and rollback hooks; off by default subnet management to preserve existing installs. See docs/private-installer/upgrade.md for upgrade/rollback guidance.
